gaps: This manifest covers only the optional read-only status feature. Existing provisioning hooks, runtime journeys and teardown still require a full separate permission reconciliation; historical dirty permission branches were not absorbed.
Effective Graph consent, supported operator role, and Azure RBAC remain unverified live; missing cached context or permissions yields pending status and never authorizes grants.

Verified ID issuer/signing-secret/security-attribute operation, user credential journeys and telemetry ingestion require separate authorized operator verification. No signing-secret or TAP read permission is requested by status.
